verdict.rationale: The only relevant item is a published notice of service unavailability on the portal ([at-financas-docs-12]). This suggests some downtime windows are announced in advance, but the notice covers customs and IEC/ISV systems rather than the tax-filing flow, and nothing shows operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts stated before a user starts. Missing for 10: published operating-hours windows for online tax filing, any per-day submission limits, session-timeout disclosure, and evidence that these appear up front in the filing flow.
